title: The *Empathy* Engine: Fine-Tuning Gemma 3 270M with LoRA for Mental Health Chatbots
dek: We aren’t just running a model; we are teaching it. Gemma 3, Unsloth and the MentalChat16K dataset, on the free tier of Google Colab.
takeaways: LoRA trains a thin layer on top of the model instead of the whole model, so this fits on Colab’s free tier.
Put MentalChat16K into Gemma 3’s chat template, then train on the assistant’s replies only.
Ask the original model the same question to check that the fine-tune changed its behaviour.
youNeed: A Google account and a Colab notebook (the free GPU is enough)
About 10,000 examples from MentalChat16K, loaded in the code
